newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai placing not to proceed.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai placing not to proceed.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd on Wednesday said a top-up placing by its controlling shareholder will not proceed as certain conditions have not been fulfilled.
"The company is no longer subject to any binding agreements to effect such top-up placing and has decided not to proceed with it," the company said in a statement.
Agreements entered into with the controlling shareholder on January 27 were subject to certain escrow conditions which had not been fulfilled, it added.
The company did not give further details of the top-up placing.
First Shanghai said earlier this month that it was exploring various alternatives to further enhancing its working capital.
"It is still the intention of the company to consider various alternatives to enhance its working capital including top-up placings," the statement said.
First Shanghai shares resumed trade on Wednesday following a one day suspension, falling HK$0.20 to HK$0.71 in early trade.
